title: Real-ticfac entrypoint test for the declared-image refusal
body:
bib was a stub/real gap: every entrypoint test that checks [sandbox].image uses a stub ticfac, which answered a call the real binary failed outside a checkout, and common.sh swallowed that failure. The fix is proven at the CLI level. Nothing drives image/common.sh repo_setup -> check_declared_image with the REAL binary and a repo declaring a different image than TICKS_SANDBOX_IMAGE. Add one to entrypoint_realticfac_test.go and assert EXIT_SETUP, so a regression in the verb or its stdout/stderr split fails a test rather than silently skipping the check.
evidence: internal/sandboximage/entrypoint_realticfac_test.go (no [sandbox].image case); internal/sandboximage/entrypoint_test.go:1147 uses the stub via TICKS_TEST_SANDBOX_IMAGE_DECLARED
